records.question: Lulu has $65 in her piggy bank. She spent $5 on ice cream. She then spent half of the remainder of the money on a t-shirt. Afterwards, she went to the bank and deposited a fifth of her remaining money. How much cash was Lulu left with?
records.response:
Lulu spent $5 on ice cream, leaving her with $65 - $5 = $60.
She then spent half of the remainder on a t-shirt, so she spent $60 / 2 = $30 on the t-shirt.
After the t-shirt purchase, she has $60 - $30 = $30 left.
She then deposited a fifth of her remaining money at the bank, so she deposited $30 / 5 = $6.
After the deposit, Lulu has $30 - $6 = $24 left in cash.
#### 24

records.question: Ronald can grill 15 hamburgers per session on his new grill.  He needs to cook 115 hamburgers in total for tonight's party.  He has already cooked 40 hamburgers.  How many more sessions will it take Ronald to finish cooking all 115 hamburgers?
records.response:
Ronald needs to cook 115 - 40 = 75 more hamburgers.
He can cook 15 hamburgers per session, so it will take him 75 / 15 = 5 more sessions.
